coverage.completeness_basis: Observed evidence only; domains and conditional fields may be incomplete

rules: A backend response must match the response schema for the selected outcome.
The response must move the session to the documented target state.
Every request contract valid in a source state must be dispatchable.
Observed counts must never be interpreted as RNG probabilities.
Unknown/unresolved modes must fail closed instead of inventing wire fields.

value.purpose: Backend dispatch table: current state + received request contract -> allowed response/outcome families.
value.probability_policy: Do not derive RNG weights from observed_count; probabilities remain unknown.

value.note: Observed counts are protocol evidence only; they are not RNG weights or probabilities.

semantics.path_completeness: Every provider/client-demonstrated executable branch must be traversed.
semantics.rng_completeness: Observed random outcomes are samples, not proof that every RNG outcome exists or was exhausted.
semantics.future_sampling_unit: Repeat each executable path independently; do not multiply unrelated modes by a scoped selector.

value.remote_replay_note: No se envían requests. La repetición del premio aleatorio no está demostrada.

value.execution_policy: server advertisement or textual client hits alone do not authorize unknown requests; only exact client-proven fully literal payload variants marked replay_eligible may be replayed

policy.coverage: Use the minimum provider-advertised wager for exhaustive protocol/path traversal; never invent a lower wager.
policy.sampling: Preserve default and full wager domain so future statistical sampling can be scheduled independently per path.
policy.purchase_identity: purchased_feature and purchased_feature_level are scoped to PURCHASE_* modes and are not global spin-option dimensions.
